style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, warm shop light
motion_rule: she sits in a swivel office chair the whole clip and the chair keeps its spot on the floor; everything else works: the clerk moth crosses the glass close to the lens in EVERY beat, coats are yanked along the rails behind her in EVERY beat, and she throws something at the lens in EVERY beat; twice she kicks the floor and the chair spins hard, at 1.8 and 7.9; new side of the chair and new shot size every beat; the last two beats are the busiest in the film; she fills half the frame height; one action per beat; no push in, no rack focus
character: a plump grey clothes moth in a brown mink coat, powdery wings, feathered antennae, round belly, in a black swivel office chair
second_characters: ONE lean moth in a green clerk visor, always within a wing of the lens, hauling coats and tags across the frame in every beat
props: ONE strip of bills she tears out of her coat at 0.0; ONE red aerosol can in the clerk legs; ONE rubber gas mask with a filter snout; furry mic bottom right
prop_continuity: the strip is hers; the can and mask are the clerk's
environment: a warm fur salon, two rails of mink coats close behind the chair, brass hangers, price tags

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty female voice, deadpan, even 4.4 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, no silent lead-in; 0.0-3.9 one breath, short breath at 3.9, 3.9-6.0 one breath; after 6.0 only the sneeze and sfx
audio.lip_sync: her mouth opens on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: hangers rattling all clip, paper tearing, fur ripping, a hissing jet at 6.0, one huge wet sneeze at 6.5

timeline.a: she tears the strip of bills out of her coat, it bursts across the lens, the clerk cutting past
she hurls a fistful of bills at the lens as the clerk drags coats along the rail behind her
she kicks the floor, the chair spins and the coat wall sweeps behind her
she hauls a coat off the rail into her lap, hangers clattering past the lens
she rips a fistful of fur out of it and flings the fur at the lens
the clerk swings a coat between her and the lens, wiping the frame
she leans out of the chair at the lens, chewing a sleeve
she spits a wad of fur at the lens, tags tearing past
the clerk lunges at the lens and fires the can, a white jet raking her
chest-up: she sneezes hard at the lens, fur wads and tags blasting past camera
the clerk flings the mask past the lens, she catches it and hauls it over her head
chest-up, mask on: she stuffs fur into the filter snout at the lens
she kicks the floor hard, the chair spins and a whole coat slides off the rail onto her head
she bursts out from under the fallen coat in the mask at the lens, fur flying past camera
she rips the next coat down into her lap and bites into it, the clerk sweeping past the glass

must_appear: the first word is heard at 0.0; the clerk is in frame in every beat; at 7.9 a coat falls on her head; at 8.7 she bursts out at the lens; at 9.4 she tears down the next coat and bites it
negative_prompt: a silent opening, a still last second, conveyor belt, cart, rail under the chair, a chair rolling across the floor, an empty frame behind her, speech bubble, subtitles, watermark, cyrillic, latin letters, printed words on props, digits, night, dark scene, a parked camera, a still background, a distant hero, a hero seen from behind, a held pose, speech after 6.0
